question: What consequence follows from seeking śakti purification without self-purification?
premises: One may attempt śakti purification instead
inference: If one pursues śakti purification in place of self-purification, success remains far away.
uncertainties: Exact syntactic role of the variant marker [j: and ātmaśuddhiḥ
plain_english: In self-purification, or as a variant self-purification, if one seeks purification of śakti instead, his success remains far away.
